notes: PayNow now owns paid ranks: purchases, refunds, gifts, and recheck grant or revoke site roles, then sync Discord and in-game Oxide groups.
Wipe automations can run on a schedule or when a map vote ends or the map starts, including applying the winning map on Pterodactyl.
BattleMetrics now requires an API key on every request, including public server player counts and map details.
added: PayNow webhook, checkout return, admin gift, and Recheck roles now grant or revoke mapped site roles.
Store-managed roles fan out to Discord guild roles and an Oxide group queue for game servers.
Admin gifts create a PayNow delivery item and grant locally; Recheck roles reconciles missed webhooks.
Admin → Automation: schedule, map-vote-end, and map-start workflows with power, RCON, delay, and apply-map-winner steps.
Pterodactyl panel settings now store seed, size, and custom map URL startup variable keys for wipe automations.
Installer installs a per-minute Laravel scheduler cron so automations and template auto-update checks actually run.
changed: PayNow product UUIDs on Admin → Roles are the entitlement map. Auto-assign, Discord booster, and verification skip those roles so they cannot fight a purchase.
Manual staff role assigns (Steam64) survive PayNow refunds. Staff removing a store role stores an exemption so it is not slapped back on.
Subscription cancel keeps access until the current period ends unless PayNow already marked the subscription failed, unpaid, or ended.
Every BattleMetrics API call sends the stored Bearer token. Server listing no longer goes out unauthenticated.
Admin → Template update now sends the Sanctum CSRF token on save and run-update, matching other admin POST/PATCH actions.
